gallery.title: File:Flickr - archer10 (Dennis) - China-6237.jpg
gallery.description: Chinese lions usually appear as male/female pairs with the male holding a ball under one paw, and the female holding a lion cub which lies on its back. One Chinese legend holds that female lions have nipples on the bottoms of their paws which they use to suckle the cub. The ball is believed to represent the union of Heaven and Earth, or the totality of Buddhist law, and the cub is believed to represent the world.

gallery.artist: Marcy Hargan from New York City (Manhattan), USA
gallery.description: This was the northernmost end of the Forbidden Palace.  Kathleen and I had been wandering about in search of Kubla Khan's stately pleasure dome, only to realize we had already found it.

gallery.title: File:Forbidden Palace 1 (82719319).jpg
gallery.artist: Marcy Hargan from New York City (Manhattan), USA
gallery.description: A front view of the Forbidden Palace. I particularly tried to get in as much of the buildings as I could because of their stark symmetry, especially against the snow. Outside mingle Chinese tourists. It is March and because winter still lingers here, the atmosphere appears particularly grim--a forbidding palace indeed.
